_comment: Photo-Fenton kinetic parameters. Each entry has value, units, source, and status.

_status_key.literature: Directly measured value from peer-reviewed source.
_status_key.uncalibrated: Structurally correct form but magnitude depends on lamp/reactor spec not available here.

k_f_ref.source: Walling 1975, Acc. Chem. Res. Measured at 25 C, pH ~3.

k_scav.source: Buxton et al. 1988, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data. OH + H2O2.

k_I.source: Lumped intermediate scavenging. Assumed similar to k_scav. Not independently measured.

k_s.source: Background OH scavenging by dissolved organics. Field-dependent. Order-of-magnitude estimate.

k_hv_h2o2.source: Representative UV-A lamp estimate. Scales with photon flux (E_p) and H2O2 molar absorption coefficient (epsilon = 18.6 L/(mol*cm) at 254 nm). Requires lamp spec to calibrate.

k_hv_fe.source: Fe3+ photoreduction rate. De Laat & Gallard 1999, Environ. Sci. Technol. Lamp-dependent.

Ea_J_mol.source: Activation energy for Fenton reaction. De Laat & Gallard 1999.

T_ref_K.source: Reference temperature for Arrhenius correction (25 C).
